title: 家族の防災行動素材
subject: 家族の防災行動素材
subject_en: A simple Japanese family cast of three: father with short black hair, mother with medium brown hair, and child with yellow backpack, bold outline pictogram-like flat style, high readability at small size, consistent colors, no real person or existing character. Always the same face, hairstyle and outfit.
